title: Guaranteed Resale Program Billing Clause: Amount of the Appraisal Charge
content:
**Clause.** The standard appraisal charge on an In-Place Home Resale file under the Guaranteed Resale Program is the package's appraisal fee, charged in full for the appraisal and rounded half up to the cent.

- *Package's appraisal fee* — the independent appraisal fee the package's guaranteed purchase schedule gives for the Guaranteed Resale Program.
- *Rounding* — half up to the cent, once, on the final figure of the charge.

| Appraisal | Charge to the seller |
|---|---|
| the appraisal the guarantee requires before listing | the package's appraisal fee, in full, rounded half up to the cent |

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** On a package whose appraisal fee is 450.00, the appraisal recorded on 6 February is charged 450.00, dated 6 February.
